name: Deep Squat Hold
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than shoulder width and toes turned comfortably outward.
Squat slowly all the way down until your hips drop deep between your heels with both feet kept flat.
Bring your palms together at your chest and press your elbows gently against your inner knees while lifting your chest tall.
Hold the deep squat steadily with calm slow breaths for the target duration before standing up gently.
tips: Slide a folded mat or small wedges beneath your heels if they lift off the floor in the bottom position.
Keep your chest proud and spine long rather than collapsing heavily into a rounded lower back.
